title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
snippet: On ChainSWE, CoReMem raises the 27B actor's resolve rate from 21.0% to 25.7%, with 17% fewer steps and 11% fewer total cache-aware tokens, including memory-module calls, relative to the untrained actor model without memory.
